In [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], the criminal [[Lannik Racto]] had an '''office''' at the upper levels of a large building on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. There, he was captured by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jaden Korr]]. Once Jaden got to the top, Racto taunted the Jedi and opened a door with a room full of assassin droids. Racto then caged himself in a giant metal box which was opened later.
